newsitems.title: SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE & PATCH 0.11
newsitems.author: brammflakes
newsitems.contents:
[h1]SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE & PATCH 0.11[/h1][h3]We are delivering a patch to improve our server browser experience.[/h3][p]Thank you for helping us hit 400,000 Peak Concurrent Users. We are completely humbled by the response to our game and we have loved watching you all play.[/p][p][/p][p]We will be taking the servers down temporarily on Monday September 14th for approximately 1 hour to run maintenance and deliver an update.[/p][h2]
SEPTEMBER 14th 2026[/h2][table colwidth="259,133"][tr][th colwidth="259"][p]Region[/p][/th][th colwidth="133"][p]Local time[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]US Pacific (PDT)[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 01:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]Mexico City[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 02:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]US Central (CDT)[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 03:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]US Eastern (EDT)[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 04:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]Brazil (Brasília)[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 05:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]UTC[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 08:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]UK, Portugal[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 09:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]Central Europe (CEST)[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 10:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]Eastern Europe, Türkiye, Moscow[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 11:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 15:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]China[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 16:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]Korea, Japan[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 17:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]Eastern Australia (AEST)[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 18:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="259"][p]New Zealand (NZST)[/p][/td][td colwidth="133"][p]Monday 20:00[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h2][b]Server Browser Improvements & Community Server Discoverability[/b][/h2][p]It's time we own up. Community Servers have been underserved and the server browser experience as a whole has been poor. It is clear to us that we have not put the same amount of care and passion into Community Servers that we have into the rest of the game.

As a result, we worked through the night to pull together an update that will start the process of improving the server browser in favour of community servers.[/p][p]Community Servers are the lifeblood of FPS games like ours. We want to make sure we actively create technology in and out of the game that supports the growth and fostering of communities. We have failed to do that by rushing our Community Server strategy. As we've always said, when we're wrong, we'll hold our hands up. We got this bit wrong.[/p][p]Below we will discuss the immediate changes to the server browser that we have made to better surface community servers. On top of which, by way of apology, for the next week community servers will offer a bonus 5% End of Match cash bonus. So if you're looking to grind, we suggest jumping in a community server.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45973082/b0e501780369cc9b886834024985afd7d35b2d65.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45973082/95ddf5e8fe65877da5b905fee421d1beada76fb4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45973082/30e0c0530d03ff69bd433561f83464fff1efb92f.png"][/img][/carousel][h3]- Split front end into two browsers, Community and Official[/h3][p][i]A game with this many players realistically should be using matchmaking, and server browsers aren't massively fit for purpose, but we don't want Community admins and hosts to suffer. They're the lifeblood of the community who keep a game running well beyond its peak player days. As a result we have added an option for players.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]- Removed unnecessary filtering from Official Servers[/h3][p][i]In its current state, filtering is not necessary for Official Servers as we do not have Official modified game modes. Filters have been removed from the Official browser.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]- Improved reliability of filtering in Community Servers[/h3][p][/p][h3]- Added text based search to Community Servers[/h3][p][/p][h3]- Community Server IDs now persist between matches and restarts[/h3][p][i]Community Server IDs were previously wiped on map change and restart. They will now persist, and each server will have its own unique ID so players can join via ID. However the number will be much longer for security reasons.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]- Added Show Empty/Full to browser quick bar[/h3][p][/p][h3]- Updated Host button to direct to the correct location[/h3][p][/p][h3]- Server name ordering and naming[/h3][p][i]We have enforced new requirements on servers to make them alphabetical regardless of special characters and numbers. You will no longer be allowed to use more than one space at a time.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Upcoming Features[/b][/h2][p][i]We are still working on a list of features we have seen requested from communities as a priority. This doesn't affect the content we're working on for Season 2, but we are heavily focused on reactive quality of life feedback for the very short term. These features are not yet ready but are in the pipeline.
[/i][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="512"][tr][th colwidth="512"][p]FEATURE[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="512"][p]Community server favouriting [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="512"][p]Tiered priority queues for Community servers [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="512"][p]Message of The Day Prompt[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="512"][p]Improved Warmup Activities[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="512"][p]AFK kicking during seeding disabling[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="512"][p]Team Switching Controls[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h2][b]Other Fixes[/b][/h2][h3]- Various cash exploits have been fixed[/h3][h3]- More GPU crashes addressed[/h3][p][/p][h2][b]Increased Capacity in Asia[/b][/h2][p]We have increased the server capacity in the Asian region to support the interest coming from that region. Thank you to our players across Asia who have shown interest and continued to play the game. We will be putting more focus into supporting Asia as an important part of the worldwide Wardogs playerbase.[/p][h2][b]Our Stance on Economy Abuse[/b][/h2][p][i]The economy of WARDOGS interlinks all players together into one shared universe and experience, even more so when we bring the meta into the game. As an early access game, we're not perfect, and we never will be. But if you do find something and take advantage of it, we have decided to come down hard. These players will be dealt with in the following ways:[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Abusing cash exploits and bugs[/b]
[i]We will respond with a timed ban, the length of which will be determined based on any previously applied bans. We will reset your cash and XP to 0.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Creating content that tutorialises economy exploits and bugs[/b][/p][p][i]We will treat creating content that tutorialises how to abuse systems, with no regard for reporting the issue, as advertising cheats. This will result in a permanent ban. There are easy ways to get things in front of us. We are not saying do not post on social media or Discord. We are saying there is a difference between promoting and alerting.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]XP farming
[/b][i]This will result in the most serious bans. We track every server you enter, and we are also very aware of which servers are XP farming servers. If your account is tracked as joining one of these servers for more than a few minutes, we will ban your account permanently.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]In the very early stages of finding these issues you may find yourself getting away with it, but it doesn't take long for our backend data to flag abusers. Effectively, if you find something and you then keep doing it, over and over again, that is abuse of an exploit. If you figure something out and test it once or twice, no biggy, thanks for helping us QA.[/p][p][/p][p]Let us know on socials and in the comments if you agree with our stance or if you think we should be adjusting it.[/p]

newsitems.title: Launch Stability Hotfix #1
newsitems.author: KingHoward
newsitems.contents: [p]We have now released a small client update to help address the issues we’ve been seeing since launch.[/p][olist][*][p][b]All currently logged-in players will be forced to close WARDOGS and restart the game.[/b][/p][/*][*][p] You will then be prompted to download the latest client update.[/p][/*][*][p]Once the update has been installed and you relaunch the game, [b]all players will return to the login queue.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]We will then begin allowing players into the game [b]in controlled batches[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]As we confirm that players are successfully entering and populating servers, we will gradually increase the number of players being let through.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This client hotfix is intended to address several of the issues we have been seeing, including:[/p][list][*][p]Players unable to join servers.[/p][/*][*][p]Players being unexpectedly kicked from servers during play.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended login queue times.[/p][/*][/list][p]We will be actively monitoring the ongoing situation post hotfix and will be working through the night to see this resolved. We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.[/p]

newsitems.title: Pre-Load Live & Season 1 Changelog
newsitems.author: brammflakes
newsitems.contents: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45973082/edf7b781f12129ce917bea66d5f0ee1f2a04d9e0.png"][/img][/h1][h2]Exploits[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an exploit that let players reach an unintended position on the church roof.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Reporting and moderation[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new report tracking system.[/p][/*][*][p]Reports are now weighted so that repeat and bad faith reporters carry less influence.[/p][/*][*][p]Cheater bans are now announced in server when match termination is turned off.[/p][/*][*][p]The kicked from server message now only appears if you were actually banned.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Server browser and front end[/h2][list][*][p]Reworked server browser filtering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed community server images scaling incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]The Host a server button now links straight to the hosting page.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Voice chat[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed voice cutting out permanently after a failed join. Stale channel rejoins, push to talk targeting and re-login all recover properly now.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved voice reliability under load, and added a visible communication status.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay and vehicles[/h2][list][*][p]Z20 Lakota balance pass, and a fix for sluggish pitch.[/p][/*][*][p]Helicopter input damping now applies to every input device.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle turrets now have a maximum operator rotation speed.[/p][/*][*][p]155mm, 122mm and flare deployables now take up more room in your loadout.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a DPI issue affecting tank aiming.[/p][/*][*][p]Brought the Z20 Lakota chase camera rotation rattle down by 6 dB.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Performance and stability[/h2][list][*][p]DLSS Frame Generation can now be turned off without restarting, and the render target pool is configurable.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced shadow cache refreshes, which cuts hitching when you take control of a character.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed two crash paths in the frame generation pipeline.[/p][/*][*][p]GPU crash reports now carry more detail, so we can act on them faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a legacy graphics dependency.[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow quality is now clamped to Low on high benchmark scores rather than being switched off entirely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by network calls scheduled off the game thread.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when closing a chatbox entry tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash involving buildables.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when firing a weapon whose owner had left.[/p][/*][*][p]Dropped items no longer affect navigation, which claws back a little performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved startup reliability, with clearer messages when something fails early and a route to recovery.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance changes[/h2][p][i]Looking at the data we have decided to slow levels down around 10 to 20, and flatten the curve from 35 onward. This means our median players, at 20 to 25 hours, will be around level 20, and those wanting the big ticket items, the top 5%, will need to grind. Artillery moves to Career 90 and Heavy Tank to Driver 35. Driver has also been rejigged to give a satisfying escalation through attack vehicles. Forward Operating Base and Large Hammer vendor prices have gone up to make them more of a choice.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Levels 10 to 20 slowed down, with the curve flattening from 35 onward.[/p][/*][*][p]Artillery moved to Career level 90, and Heavy Tank moved to Driver level 35.[/p][/*][*][p]Forward Operating Base and Large Hammer vendor prices raised so they are more of a choice.[/p][/*][/list][h2]XP Bands[/h2][p][i]Previously our balancing was designed specifically for weekend long beta tests. Now they will be in-line with where we believe they should be. Each season we will have a different XP curve with different item orders.[/i] [/p][list][*][p]Below level 6: unchanged.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 6: 8,750 to 9,250, 5.7% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 10: 25,000 to 35,000, 40.0% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 15: 54,750 to 110,000, 100.9% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 20: 111,500 to 250,000, 124.2% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 25: 192,000 to 325,000, 69.3% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 30: 293,750 to 400,000, 36.2% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 35: 416,500 to 500,000, 20.0% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 40: 551,250 to 650,000, 17.9% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 45: 689,500 to 800,000, 16.0% slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 50: 838,000 to 1,000,000, 19.3% slower.[/p][/*][/list][h2]XP Events[/h2][list][*][p]Player kill using an air vehicle: 300 XP to 250 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Supply crate item sold under $75: 25 XP to 1 XP.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Economy Changes[/h2][p][i]Every price change in one place. Level moves stay with their track.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Vendor, Forward Operating Base: $2,500 to $7,500.[/p][/*][*][p]Vendor, Large Hammer: $1,600 to $2,400.[/p][/*][*][p]Career, Artillery Tank: $400,000 to $500,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Recon, 6-10x MRAD scope: $25,000 to $40,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Recon, 6-10x MOA scope: $30,000 to $45,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Support, Medium Hammer: $10,000 to $25,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Support, Large Hammer: $25,000 to $75,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot, small armoured supply crate: $5,000 to $10,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot, Little Bird with miniguns: $25,000 to $50,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot, Z20 Lakota: $50,000 to $35,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Driver, URAL: $50,000 to $35,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Driver, Dune Buggy: $35,000 to $25,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Driver, Kodiak Flatbed: $15,000 to $35,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Driver, Music Tape H: $5,000 to $2,500.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the role track XP curve from level 6 upward. Level 6 moves from 8,750 to 9,250, roughly 5.7% slower, with a larger increase at level 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Rescaled the supply crate purchase curve from 25 to 250 down to 1 to 200, so low value items are priced sensibly and cannot be abused.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Season 1.0 Unlocks: Career[/h2][list][*][p]Sports Parachute: level 36 to level 35.[/p][/*][*][p]Large Backpack: level 56 to level 55.[/p][/*][*][p]762x54mm AP: level 83 to level 82.[/p][/*][*][p]556mm AP: level 85 to level 83.[/p][/*][*][p]Deagle: level 90 to level 85.[/p][/*][*][p]Artillery Tank: level 55 to level 90.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Season 1.0 Unlocks: Medic[/h2][list][*][p]PP-19 50 round drum magazine: level 33 to level 29.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Season 1.0 Unlocks: Support[/h2][list][*][p]Large Hammer: level 7 to level 8.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Season 1.0 Unlocks: Driver[/h2][list][*][p]URAL: level 4 to level 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Kodiak Assault: level 8 to level 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Dune Buggy: level 10 to level 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Kodiak Flatbed: level 2 to level 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Large Supply Crate: level 20 to level 16.[/p][/*][*][p]URAL Covered: level 30 to level 18.[/p][/*][*][p]Music Tape H: moves from Pilot level 28 to Driver level 23.[/p][/*][*][p]URAL Attack: level 40 to level 25.[/p][/*][*][p]Humvee with minigun: level 35 to level 30.[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy Tank: moves from Career level 35 to Driver level 35.[/p][/*][/list]

[p]The 11th Reason NOT to Buy WARDOGS.[/p][previewyoutube="s1YpSHod0FA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The 11th Reason NOT to Buy WARDOGS. There's a rule in game development: you don't talk about anti-cheat.[/p][p]The most important thing you can do: use the in-game report function on official servers and for the ultimate protection, play on community hosted servers where admins can instantly ban bad actors.

Community Hosted Servers are available to pre-order now through our 3 Approved Hosting Partners; QONZER, BisectHosting and xREALM, ahead of WARDOGS Early Access launch on September 10th.

The $100K Clip Contest is still running. Share your best moments with #wardogs100k or submit at [url="https://wardogs100k.com"]wardogs100k.com[/url].  New here? Watch our 10 Reasons NOT to Buy WARDOGS first.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Our launch trailer goes live September 10th - see you on the other side![/b][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ugkuP4a3xk4"][/dynamiclink]  WARDOGS Early Access: September 10th.[/p]
